title: Allreduce bus bandwidth is very low and unstable when ECE (enhanced connection establishment) is enabled.
body: I have two machines, each with 8 H100-80G GPUs and 4 400Gbps CX7 RDMA network cards with RoCE2. And the nccl version is 2.22.3+cuda12.5. I used nccl-tests to evaluate the allreduce performance and found that the bus bandwidth was very low and unstable. ```shell # mpirun -np 16 -map-by node --allow-run-as-root --hostfile ../myhostfile -x NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/nccl22.3/build/lib ./build/all_reduce_perf -b 2G -e 20G -f 2 # nThread 1 nGpus 1 minBytes 2147483648 maxBytes 21474836480 step: 2(factor) warmup iters: 5 iters: 20 agg iters: 1 validation: 1 graph: 0 # # Using devices # Rank 0 Group 0 Pid 283571 on xx device 0 [0x1b] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 1 Group 0 Pid 287301 on xx device 0 [0x1b] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 2 Group 0 Pid 283572 on xx device 1 [0x29] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 3 Group 0 Pid 287302 on xx device 1 [0x29] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 4 Group 0 Pid 283573 on xx device 2 [0x45] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 5 Group 0 Pid 287303 on xx device 2 [0x45] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 6 Group 0 Pid 283574 on xx device 3 [0x4e] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 10 Group 0 Pid 283576 on xx device 5 [0x24] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 11 Group 0 Pid 287306 on xx device 5 [0x24] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 12 Group 0 Pid 283577 on xx device 6 [0x45] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 13 Group 0 Pid 287307 on xx device 6 [0x45] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 14 Group 0 Pid 283578 on xx device 7 [0x4e] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # Rank 15 Group 0 Pid 287308 on xx device 7 [0x4e] NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 # # out-of-place in-place # size count type redop root time algbw busbw #wrong time algbw busbw #wrong # (B) (elements) (us) (GB/s) (GB/s) (us) (GB/s) (GB/s) 2147483648 536870912 float sum -1 282996 7.59 14.23 4.09366e+09 265491 8.09 15.17 4.09366e+09 4294967296 1073741824 float sum -1 575502 7.46 13.99 8.18734e+09 576558 7.45 13.97 8.18726e+09 8589934592 2147483648 float sum -1 1247496 6.89 12.91 1.63745e+10 1206310 7.12 13.35 1.63746e+10 17179869184 4294967296 float sum -1 2533505 6.78 12.71 3.2749e+10 2491284 6.90 12.93 3.27492e+10 # Out of bounds values : 64 FAILED # Avg bus bandwidth : 13.6577 # ``` After analysis, I discovered that when I commented out the following code to disable the ECE feature, the nccl-tests allreduce performance was as expected and stable: ```shell # mpirun -np 16 -map-by node --allow-run-as-root --hostfile ../myhostfile -x NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/nccl22.3/build/lib ./build/all_reduce_perf -b 2G -e 20G -f 2 # nThread 1 nGpus 1 minBytes 2147483648 maxBytes 21474836480 step: 2(factor) warmup iters: 5 iters: 20 agg iters: 1 validation: 1 graph: 0 #
